title_sq: Tek Ali Demi, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Ideal Per Investim!!

title_en: At Ali Demi, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment!!
description_en: In Ali Dem, on Idriz Dollaku street, 1+1 apartment for sale in a new building!!! The apartment is located on the 1st floor of the residence, in a residential and service building with 1 and 4 floors and 1 underground parking floor. The apartment has an East orientation. It has a gross area of ​​65 m², a net area of ​​52 m². The apartment is organized as follows: distribution corridor, living room and kitchen area, double bedroom and toilet. The materials that are being used and new construction technologies, both in the realization of refinishing and in the realization of hydro-insulating layers, the realization of the double wall that separates the apartments between them and the external environment, acoustic insulation, hydraulic equipment of quality brands, quality windows, the multisplit air conditioning system make the quality of the construction to be maximum. The construction is currently in the facade phase and will be completed within 1 year.
